text: Hulɓinir -an Nulaaɗo- yimɓe ɓen Ñalnde Nimse tuma nimsata bonnuɗo on e hoore bonnere makko nden, moƴƴinɗo on kadi [nimsa] anngal hibbingol makko ɗoftaare nden, tuma nde ɗeri dewal ngal taggaa, hasboore maɓɓe nden timmi, gooto kala hikkondiri e ko o ardinnoo kon, hari kamɓe ka ngurndam maɓɓe aduna ko ɓe hoditorɓe ɗam, ko ɓe welsindiiɓe fii Laakara, toode kamɓe ɓe gomɗinaano Ñalnde Darngal.
